name: Slovenia Julian Alps + Venice Gateway Loop

dates.why: Built to match the current comparison window: depart Monday, August 31 and return Sunday, September 13.

exchangeRateNote: International lodging/activity costs are USD planning estimates; live booking should re-price in local currency before purchase.
positioning: An Austria-adjacent alternative that keeps the alpine lake/farm/spa feeling but shifts the center of gravity to Slovenia: Bled, Bohinj, Soča Valley, Ljubljana, and a Venice airport buffer.
routeRationale: Use Venice as the Delta-friendly gateway and avoid a complicated Ljubljana connection with a baby.
Start at Bled because it gives the fastest alpine payoff after landing.
Move Bled → Bohinj → Soča in a westward mountain arc to reduce backtracking.
Finish in Ljubljana for stroller-friendly city comfort, then protect the flight with a Venice airport buffer night.

recommended.label: Delta-first Venice gateway
recommended.infantNote: Budget includes two adult cash fares plus infant-in-lap international fee/tax estimate; re-check Delta before booking.

outbound.flight: DL ATL-VCE seasonal nonstop / Delta-marketed alternative

return.flight: DL VCE-ATL seasonal nonstop / Delta-marketed alternative

bases.name: Lake Bled farm/glamping base
bases.why: Closest match to the farm/nature stay vibe while keeping Bled walkable.

bases.name: Lake Bohinj mountain-water base
bases.why: Quieter lake base with mountain access and baby-friendly recovery options.

bases.name: Soča Valley adventure-light base
bases.why: Gives the emerald river/mountain drama without needing intense adventure sports.

bases.name: Ljubljana + Venice buffer
bases.why: City comfort plus a protected flight home.

dailyItinerary.title: Delta nonstop ATL to Venice
dailyItinerary.transport: Depart ATL on Delta ATL-VCE seasonal nonstop planning snapshot, evening departure and morning Venice arrival; book two adult Main Cabin tickets and add infant-in-lap.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Flight logistics day: keep the Slovenia loop simple by using Venice as the gateway, then driving straight into the Julian Alps after a reset stop.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: If ATL-VCE prices spike, compare Delta/KLM/Air France one-stop routings into Venice, Ljubljana via partner connection, or Munich with a longer drive.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Airport dinner and baby snacks; pack sleep kit, stroller gate-check, carrier, bottles, and one change for everyone.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Infant-in-lap; budget includes an international infant fee estimate and taxes.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Book transatlantic flights first; all lodging dates depend on the Venice arrival/return.
dailyItinerary.why: Venice keeps this Slovenia-focused Alps loop realistic from Atlanta: one gateway, a straightforward rental car pickup, and less time lost crossing Europe with a one-year-old.
moments: Choose the Venice nonstop/Delta-first routing before locking hotels.
Keep arrival morning gentle: no sightseeing pressure, just bags, car seat, and the drive into Slovenia.
Use this route to make Slovenia the core, not a side trip.
dailyItinerary.costNote: Transport is the full round-trip flight budget for two adults plus infant-in-lap estimate.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Arrive Venice and drive to Lake Bled
dailyItinerary.transport: Pick up rental car at Venice Marco Polo and drive to Lake Bled, about 3 hours before baby stops and border timing.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Settle into Garden Village Bled, walk the lakeshore, and keep the first evening about fresh air, dinner, and sleep.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: If arrival is rough, stop near Udine/Tarvisio for lunch and go straight to the room instead of lakeshore exploring.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Groceries/snacks plus relaxed dinner at Garden Village or Bled town; budget $175.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Long transfer, but nap-friendly. Request crib, kettle, and early dinner seating.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Confirm rental car cross-border permission for Italy-Slovenia and child-seat plan.
dailyItinerary.why: This is the reveal: instead of lingering near Venice, the trip immediately becomes alpine Slovenia, with Bled as the softest, prettiest landing pad.
moments: Drive once, unpack, and let the lake reset everyone.
Use the lakeshore path as the baby-friendly first activity.
Garden Village gives the farm/glamping texture that echoes the Switzerland vibe.
dailyItinerary.costNote: Transport includes the full rental-car budget for the Slovenia loop, allocated on pickup day.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Lake Bled island, castle views, and cream cake
dailyItinerary.transport: Local Bled driving/walking only; use stroller for lakeshore and carrier for castle grades.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Morning pletna-style lake/island view plan, Bled Castle viewpoint, lakeside playground/walk, and cafe stop for kremšnita.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: Skip the boat/castle if weather is wet and do Bled lakeshore plus Radovljica old town.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Breakfast at stay, lakeside lunch, casual dinner; budget $190.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Stroller works on flat lakeshore; carrier for castle and older paths.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Reserve any boat/castle timing only after checking weather.
dailyItinerary.why: Bled is famous for a reason: island church, castle, lake path, mountain backdrop, and enough easy surfaces for a toddler-paced day.
moments: Take the classic lake/island view while energy is highest.
Use a nap break back at Garden Village.
End with a low-pressure lakeside dinner rather than a second excursion.
dailyItinerary.costNote: Activities cover castle/boat-style sightseeing buffer for two adults.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Vintgar Gorge and Radovljica honey town
dailyItinerary.transport: Bled to Vintgar Gorge and Radovljica loop, roughly 45 minutes total driving.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Early Vintgar Gorge boardwalk walk, then Radovljica old town, honey/bee museum style stop, and easy farm-country lunch.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: If Vintgar is crowded or wet, do Lake Bohinj preview or Bled wellness/pool time.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Radovljica lunch, grocery dinner or Garden Village dinner; budget $185.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Carrier is safer for gorge boardwalk; use stroller in Radovljica.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Pre-book Vintgar timed entry if required for the season.
dailyItinerary.why: This adds texture beyond postcard Bled: gorge water, wooden walkways, bees/honey, and a small-town Slovenia feel.
moments: Start early before crowds.
Make Radovljica the crawl-around/reset town stop.
Keep afternoon unplanned for naps and weather.
dailyItinerary.costNote: Vintgar timed-entry and small museum/cafe buffer.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Transfer to Bohinj and Vogel mountain views
dailyItinerary.transport: Bled to Bohinj, about 35 minutes, then short drive to Vogel cable car base.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Move to Bohinj, ride Vogel cable car if clear, and spend late afternoon on Lake Bohinj shore.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: If clouds hide the view, skip Vogel and use Aquapark Bohinj / hotel pool time.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Bohinj lakeside lunch and hotel dinner; budget $185.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Cable car is baby-friendly with carrier; bring layers for the top.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Check Vogel operating hours and weather the night before.
dailyItinerary.why: Bohinj is the quieter, wilder counterpoint to Bled: less polished, more mountain-valley, and ideal for a slower family base.
moments: Keep the transfer short.
Use Vogel only if the view is worth it.
Let Lake Bohinj be the evening reset.
dailyItinerary.costNote: Includes cable car buffer for two adults.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Lake Bohinj slow shore and farm-country day
dailyItinerary.transport: Short local drives around Bohinj only.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Lake Bohinj shoreline walk, Ukanc/Zlatorog area, simple picnic, and farm-valley exploring without a big objective.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: If weather is poor, use Aquapark Bohinj and a cafe lunch in Bohinjska Bistrica.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Picnic groceries, lakeside cafe, hotel dinner; budget $175.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: This is a true baby day: grass, water views, stroller sections, and room/pool reset.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: No hard booking; protect this as a low-pressure day.
dailyItinerary.why: After five travel/sightseeing days, this one earns its place by not asking too much: beautiful water, mountain air, and time for the baby to actually explore.
moments: Morning lakeshore before day-trippers peak.
Picnic instead of a formal lunch.
Afternoon pool/nap buffer at the hotel.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Kranjska Gora and Lake Jasna alpine picnic
dailyItinerary.transport: Bohinj to Kranjska Gora/Lake Jasna and back, about 2h30m total driving.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Scenic drive to Kranjska Gora, Lake Jasna picnic/walk, and optional Planica Nordic center stop.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: Stay in Bohinj and do Savica Waterfall viewpoint if the longer drive feels like too much.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Picnic lunch, Kranjska Gora cafe, hotel dinner; budget $185.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Break the drive around nap; Lake Jasna has easy stroller-friendly edges.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Keep this flexible; it is the optional high-alpine day.
dailyItinerary.why: Lake Jasna gives the glassy alpine-lake look and Julian Alps drama without a major hike.
moments: Use the drive as scenic nap time.
Walk the lake rather than stacking activities.
Treat Planica as a bonus, not a requirement.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Vršič Pass to Soča Valley and Bovec
dailyItinerary.transport: Bohinj/Kranjska Gora side to Bovec via Vršič Pass and Soča Valley, about 2h45m before viewpoint stops.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Drive the Vršič Pass, stop at safe viewpoints, then settle into Bovec with a short Soča river walk.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: If weather is rough, use the easier Predel/Tarvisio routing and go straight to Bovec.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Mountain-pass lunch stop, Bovec dinner; budget $190.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Carrier for viewpoints; avoid ambitious hikes on transfer day.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Confirm Dobra Vila crib/parking and check pass conditions.
dailyItinerary.why: This is the route day that makes Slovenia feel epic: switchbacks, limestone peaks, and the emerald Soča reveal.
moments: Treat Vršič as the activity, not just transportation.
Stop only where parking/safety are easy with the baby.
Arrive early enough for a calm Bovec dinner.
dailyItinerary.costNote: Transport covers mountain transfer fuel/parking/tolls buffer.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Soča River, Kobarid, and Kozjak Waterfall
dailyItinerary.transport: Bovec to Kobarid and Kozjak area, about 1h15m total driving.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Soča river viewpoints, Kobarid history/old town lunch, and Kozjak Waterfall carrier walk if trail conditions are good.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: Skip Kozjak with wet footing and use Tolmin/Kobarid cafes plus riverside viewpoints.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Carrier only for Kozjak; avoid slippery sections if rain.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Check trail/parking notes and weather before committing.
dailyItinerary.why: The Soča Valley is the adventure-looking part of Slovenia, but this version keeps it family-scaled: river color, short walks, and good food towns.
moments: Prioritize turquoise river stops over mileage.
Make Kobarid the civilized lunch/reset point.
Use Kozjak only if it feels safe and dry.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Bovec slow day and optional Kanin lift views
dailyItinerary.transport: Local Bovec day; optional lift/base-area driving only.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Bovec town, easy Soča access points, optional Kanin lift/viewpoint if operating, and a true slow afternoon.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: If lifts are closed/weather is poor, do a short drive to Great Soča Gorge viewpoints and cafe time.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Bovec cafe lunch, nicer dinner; budget $200.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Keep this as a recovery day between the pass/river days and Ljubljana transfer.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Check Kanin operation status before treating it as the plan.
dailyItinerary.why: This gives the itinerary breathing room in the most rugged region, with a weather-dependent mountain-view option but no pressure to perform.
moments: Let the baby reset after two big scenery days.
Use Soča river access as sensory play.
Make the lift a bonus, not the day’s success condition.
dailyItinerary.costNote: Activity budget includes optional lift/cable car style spend.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Transfer to Ljubljana via Postojna Cave
dailyItinerary.transport: Bovec to Ljubljana via Postojna Cave, about 3h20m driving plus cave stop.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Drive toward Ljubljana with Postojna Cave as the weather-proof wow stop, then check into Ljubljana for city comfort.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: If the cave timing is too much, skip Postojna and stop in Vipava Valley for lunch.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Postojna’s train/cave can work with layers and carrier; keep stroller expectations modest.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Pre-book cave time if choosing Postojna; request crib at Ljubljana hotel.
dailyItinerary.why: This day changes gears from alpine roads to Slovenia’s polished capital, with one distinctive cave stop that works even if weather turns.
moments: Use Postojna as the built-in rainy-day attraction.
Arrive in Ljubljana before dinner.
Enjoy a real hotel reset after mountain guesthouses.
dailyItinerary.costNote: Includes Postojna tickets for two adults.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Ljubljana market, castle, and riverfront
dailyItinerary.transport: Walk/taxi day in Ljubljana; no meaningful driving.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Central market, riverfront stroller walk, funicular/castle view, Tivoli Park crawl-around time, and farm-to-table dinner.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: If everyone needs a break, skip castle and do market plus Tivoli only.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Market breakfast/lunch, good Ljubljana dinner; budget $230.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Best stroller day of the trip: compact, flat center with parks and cafes.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Reserve dinner if choosing a specific farm-to-table restaurant.
dailyItinerary.why: Ljubljana gives the trip a civilized finale: beautiful but manageable, with cafes, markets, river paths, and parks that fit a one-year-old.
moments: Use the market as breakfast/lunch theater.
Castle only if the day is going well.
Let Tivoli Park be the baby’s real activity.
dailyItinerary.costNote: Activity budget covers funicular/castle and small city attractions.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Trieste coast or Venice airport buffer
dailyItinerary.transport: Ljubljana to Venice airport area, with optional Trieste/Miramare stop, about 3 hours before stops.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Return toward Italy, stop at Trieste/Miramare if timing works, return rental car or sleep near Venice airport for the flight home.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: Drive direct to the airport hotel and keep the day intentionally boring.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Trieste lunch or airport-area dinner; budget $190.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Protect the return flight: do not make this a predawn Slovenia-to-Venice drive.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Book airport hotel and confirm car-return hours.
dailyItinerary.why: This buffer day makes the international return sane. With a baby, sleeping near the airport beats gambling on a long morning drive.
moments: Only stop in Trieste if the drive is smooth.
Return car/check bags logistics calmly.
Make dinner early and simple.
dailyItinerary.costNote: Airport hotel and return-drive costs only; flight already counted on Day 1.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

dailyItinerary.title: Fly Venice to Atlanta
dailyItinerary.transport: Return Venice to Atlanta on Delta/partner Venice-ATL planning snapshot; use direct Delta seasonal flight if operating or Delta-partner connection if not.
dailyItinerary.primaryActivity: Breakfast, airport check-in, stroller gate-check, and flight home.
dailyItinerary.backupActivity: If nonstop is unavailable, choose the shortest Delta-marketed one-stop routing with enough connection padding for a stroller/car seat.
dailyItinerary.foodPlan: Airport breakfast/lunch and baby snacks; budget $110.
dailyItinerary.babyPlan: Keep the airport morning simple and early; infant-in-lap already included in Day 1 flight budget.
dailyItinerary.bookingPriority: Confirm exact return schedule when booking flights.
dailyItinerary.why: A practical departure day keeps the Slovenia trip feeling polished rather than frantic.
moments: Wake at the airport rather than on the road.
Use stroller/carrier until boarding.
Keep snacks and spare clothes accessible.
dailyItinerary.costNote: Return-day local costs only; round-trip airfare is allocated on Day 1.
dailyItinerary.pitchTitle: Why this day earns its spot

routeLabel: Venice → Bled → Bohinj → Soča Valley → Ljubljana → Venice
